Cat Back

Cat Back

Shop Subaru cat-back exhaust systems at IAG Performance for 2002–2023 WRX, STI, Legacy GT, Forester XT, and BRZ models. Cat-back exhausts are a popular upgrade for improving exhaust flow, sound, and overall performance. Choose from a wide range of pipe diameters and exhaust tip styles to match your setup. We carry high-quality cat-back systems from trusted brands like AWE Tuning, Borla, COBB, CORSA Performance, ETS, GReddy, HKS, Injen, Invidia, LP Adventure, MBRP, MagnaFlow, Mishimoto, TurboXS, and aFe.
